latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Generator by Image skill.
- Instantly turn uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, max 200MB) into videos with transitions and music, no editing experience required.
- Connects automatically to the cloud video creation API; free trial token supported.
- Supports export to 1080p MP4 and several other popular media formats.
- Responsive to common prompt types: upload, export, show balance, check status, edit, and generate.
- Clear error messaging for issues like file type, size, credits, or expired token.
